{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Output the result
print(mean_revenue)"}
